overview: Spin-off of Country Love, it revolves around the romance, marriage, career and life of the villagers in Xiangshanya Village. The veteran was injured when he saved Dana's father during the war, and the shrapnel left inside his brain causes him to suffer from intermittent memory loss. In order to repay the favor, Dana asked his son to take the veteran back to his old age, but due to Musheng's negligence, the veteran was lost. All the villagers in Xiangya Mountain finally find him, and they also set up the Xiangya Mountain Helpers Group to praise the virtue of helping each other and award all of them with the title of "Good People of Xiangya Mountain.". When the veteran's memory was confused and he went back to the war era, the villagers acted together with him to help him recall his memory and also found his long-lost comrade so that the old man could fulfill his heart's desire. In the process, everyone experienced their whole military career, from joining the army to resisting U.S. aggression and aiding Korea. Everyone grew up greatly, as if they had been soldiers. Meanwhile, it also made everyone realize that without the bloodshed of the revolutionary forefathers, there would be no peace today. So we should cherish today's hard-won happy life and be grateful.
title: Good Folks of Xiangya Mountain

overview: "George and Mildred" is a British sitcom produced by Thames Television that aired from 1976 to 1979. It was a spin-off from Man About the House and starred Brian Murphy and Yootha Joyce as an ill-matched married couple, George and Mildred Roper.
title: George and Mildred

overview: When Panu's twin children Oley and Nene want Karaked, a teacher, to be their stepmom, the two start to play cupid. But their obstacles are General Samurjai, Karaked's father who tries every way to intervene between Panu and Karaked and the twin's maternal grandmother Khun Nuankae, who wants to take custody of the two children. So Panu must use his love and sincerity to prove to everyone.
title: Por Mai Lek Tai Song Tua

overview: Adapted from the novel short story collection "Yuming Tribute Stories" inspired by the songs of Matsutoya Yumi.
title: Yuming Stories

overview: Khlao a poor farmer with a lot of debt falls in love with a young woman from a rich family named Thong Kwao but their relationship is not approved by Thong Kwao's parents because Khlao is poor. Thong Kwao was sent to Bangkok by her parents, so Thong Kwao could get a man who really matched her parents' wishes. Khlao also has many women who want to get his love and this creates many misunderstandings that can separate the love between Khlao and Thong Kwao.
title: Mon Rak Luk Thung 2567
The Theory of Original Family or Crime

overview: Bounty hunter Shen Bingfan joins the Northern Bureau of the Jinyiwei (Imperial Guard), the emperor's elite secret guard, to uncover the truth behind her father's wrongful case. There, she becomes a female Jinyiwei agent alongside Cheng Xintian and Hua Mange. As they investigate a string of bizarre cases, she forms unlikely alliances with the mysterious proprietor Chang Beiming, the lowly handyman Xu Duoyu, and others. Together, they take on corrupt power, solve impossible mysteries, and gradually uncover the truth behind her father's murder years ago...
title: Angels and Guards

overview: Four teens with distinct personalities form a band and navigate the challenges of trust, identity, and emotional growth. As mysterious events unfold, their bonds are tested, revealing deeper truths about love and connection.
title: A Summer Odyssey

overview: Adapted from the novel "Gu Jie" (古街) by Liu Yu Xin (刘育新).
title: Ancient Street

overview: Bai Xiaochun, a kind-hearted and free-spirited, always uses his own methods to help people who he thinks is in need. This leads to many hilarious situations, and he is regarded by villagers as a rebellious kid. After he gets into the famous Ling Xi Sect, he meets a few like-minded friends, each with their own capabilities and quirks. Together, they form a team set to uphold justice. A few years later, Bai Xiaochun grows up and become a hot-blooded and responsible young hero. Bai Xiaochun sets out on a journey to restore world peace and in the process, gains friendship and love.
title: An Eternal Thought

overview: This emotional epic is set against the background of rural land changes in southern Shandong and spanning the period from late 1926 to 1944. Focusing on the legend of women's growth, it displays the farmers' difficult journey of survival and development under feudal rule, as well as their inseparable attachment to the land from generation to generation.
title: This Thriving Land

overview: The Gasforth police station often is the scene of comic discord between the uniformed officers led by Inspector Raymond Fowler and the detectives under the supervision of Detective Inspector Derek Grim.
title: The Thin Blue Line

overview: It is adapted from the novel "Senior, You Will Lose Me Easily Like This" by Yiren KuiKui and tells the story of a demonic sect saint who is reborn and falls in love with a righteous male protagonist. Wangyue, the enchanting and unpredictable saint of the Holy Fire Sect, miraculously survives a deadly situation and transforms into a destitute orphan. She is determined to fulfill her unrealized wish: to be united with Yang Qing, an elder of a prestigious righteous sect. With this desire in her heart, Wangyue, who has been given a second chance at life, coincidentally meets and gets to know Yang Qing. Eventually, the two join forces in the martial world, working together to defeat the real mastermind behind the chaos. They strive to bring about reconciliation between the Holy Fire Sect and the righteous sect, bringing peace and prosperity to the world.
title: A Forbidden Marriage

overview: What would you do if you accidentally found yourself inside the world of a script, playing the role of a tragic female lead used and discarded by the villainous male lead, even tortured to death? For Song Xiaoyu, the answer is obvious: run as far away as possible. She had the perfect escape plan, but reality said otherwise. Every time she tries to change the storyline or marry a supporting male character, she becomes trapped in a never-ending loop full of "bugs," dying in 108 unique and absurd ways. In short, the game was over for her the moment it began. Eventually, Xiaoyu comes to a painful realization: no matter how hard she tries, the "plot" always pulls her back to the male lead, Nan Heng, forcing her to re-enact the script's iconic scenes again and again. In this paper-thin world, so many characters are shackled by predestined roles. Some are imprisoned in palace intrigues, others are confined in grand aristocratic mansions. Some are trapped in toxic rivalries among women, while others endlessly pursue power and status. Some yearn for love and freedom but can only dance in fear, bound by invisible chains. Some dream of soaring like mighty birds, only to lose their spirit amid the monotony of daily life. This drama portrays the struggle of ordinary individuals fighting against a fate that was scripted from the very beginning.
title: A Dream Within a Dream

overview: A mysterious killer forces presenter Markus Neby and ten celebrities to tackle the traditional Easter in a non-traditional way - or die.
title: Påskekrimlekene

overview: Funny, charming, and sarcastic Mueang is a 27-year-old outspoken eco-warrior geologist who enjoys tree-hugging as a pastime. While Apo/View is a 27-year-old architect who wears her heart on her sleeve, is overworked and recently dumped by her company, and goes on the deep end when her boyfriend cheats on her. Cupid strikes the moment Mueang and View set eyes on each other, sparks fly... one innocent conversation leads to another, and they unexpectedly spend the night together. Their overnight rendezvous in a cozy camper by the sea was chaotically unforgettable. But the following day, when Mueang gets up, he finds that Apo had left without leaving any details of her contact or whereabouts.
title: Jon Kwa Ja Dai Ruk Gun

overview: Julien, Judith, Mathieu and Lucile, almost orphans, reject their father, Paul-Émile de Léry, after the suicide of their mother. An unexpected event will brings them together again: to inherit his colossal fortune, they must enter into a ruthless competition. The trials unearth family secrets, rekindling the pain of the past. Even in death, Paul-Émile exercises his power over them.
title: In Memoriam

overview: Drama Queens promises an authentic and aspirational glimpse into the lives of some of the nation's favourite stars from three of the most iconic soaps in the UK – Hollyoaks, Coronation Street and Emmerdale, taking viewers beyond the scripted drama of the screen, and into the real lives of soap personalities.
title: Drama Queens

overview: Cherkwan has the same fate as Miss. Cinderella who had both an evil stepmother and jealous older sister waiting to snatch what rightfully belongs to her. She has to flee to Phaya Lo mountain to escape being duped into a marriage and set up for the murder of the groom. To ask for aid, she intends to run to wealthy landowner Chalaybutr, the older brother of a friend who'd fallen for her before they'd ever met, but mistakenly meets another wealthy man, Khetkham, handsome and cool but rutheless. Cherkwan's princess-like beauty reignites the flames of love and resentment between the two eternal enemies, Khetkham and Chalaybutr.
title: Waowon Rak

overview: Hanasaki Mai works as a teller for a branch of Tokyo Daiichi Bank. Suddenly, she gets transferred to the Tokyo Daiichi Bank's headquarters office. Her job is to fix problems that arise at its various local branch offices. Hanasaki Mai has the type of personality where if she believes she is right, she cannot keep quiet about it or give up. At her new department, she sees many mistakes that take place inside the bank, which she never noticed before.
title: Hanasaki Mai ga Damattenai

overview: Buabongkot thought that after fifteen years of marriage and stability with Poramet, nothing would change. That is, until the day she learned of her husband's affair. Instead of accepting she's lost, Buabongkot decides to stand up for justice in her marriage.
title: Songkhram Somrot

overview: The show revolved around two police officers who investigated homicides in San Francisco. The center of the series was a veteran cop and widower, Lt Mike Stone (Karl Malden), who had more than 20 years of police experience and was now assigned to the Homicide Detail of SFPD's Bureau of Inspectors. He was partnered with a young, energetic partner, Assistant Inspector Steve Keller (Michael Douglas), a college graduate, age 28, who had no police experience. Stone would become a second father to Keller as he learned the rigors and procedures of detective work.
title: The Streets of San Francisco

overview: La-ojan has just graduated from France and applies to be a secretary for Mom Luang Phuthanet Juthathep. Her intention is to steal the "Ajna Chakra" necklace, a precious piece of jewellery from Wiang Phu Kham which was sent to be displayed at the JT Center Mall owned by Phuthanet. During this time, their relationship slowly builds. He has fallen in love with her at first sight, and La-ojan grows gradually more attracted to him too.
title: Laorchan

overview: Tien has been raised as a boy all her life because Kamontat, her ill-willed father, swapped her with the family's gardener/caretaker's son in his estate in Hua hin, leaving behind a ring strung in a necklace as key to her true identity. Before Grandpa Thaksasoot died, he declared that he wanted a boy to carry the family name since Thorn, her father's brother, who also later died, can't have children. Years later, Kamontat searched for Tien because he doesn't want his adopted son to inherit the money. Thorn and Rome were best friends and one fateful day, Rome met Tien and saved her from an unlikely situation; not knowing at first that she is a girl, brought her home and took care of her. Then Rome discovered Tien's true identity as the missing heiress to the Thaksasoot family fortune. Some years back, Rome was financially ruined by Kamontat. Driven by revenge, Rome kept the truth to himself but later admitted it and helped to get Tien back to her rightful place in the family.
title: Ngao Kammathep

overview: Ronnachak has the chance to meet Jaiphisut who is his childhood friend because she is a teacher for Sunida, his dead friend's sister who asked him to take care of her before he died. Jaiphisut is unhappy to meet him because she can remember how he teased her. She needs to make up the relationship between Sunida and Pemnuch, unaware that they become friends and try to bring Ronnachak and Jaiphisut back together.
title: Jaiphisut

overview: A scary criminal and the cop who was trying to catch him need to collab together to face supernatural forces and join the fight against a powerful organization, while also getting involved with the daughter of a scientist and a female criminal.
title: Praai Pikart

overview: What would you do if you inherited a home that you didn't know existed? Jean Johansson follows the hunt for the rightful heirs to properties, but will they keep or sell their key to a fortune?
title: Key to a Fortune

overview: Philip Boucher-Hayes goes on an extraordinary journey across the planet to see how climate change is already affecting the world and to find out what it means for us in Ireland.
title: Rising Tides - Ireland's Future in a Warmer World

overview: Cha SooHyuk is focused only on his survival, without any grand goal. He reunites with Lee YoonDae, who he was very close with. YoonDae was living with his girlfriend but now has nowhere to go. They end up living together.
title: Gray Shelter

overview: JinWoo, is a young man who finds himself living with his crush, KiSub, who entered his home uninvited and crashed on his couch for a little too long. The narrative also explores the relationship between Sunny and InHo, who hold onto a secret from their high school days.
title: Boys Be Brave

overview: In Jakten på förstasidan, we get to follow the actors Emma Molin and Eric Stern on an adventurous journey through Sweden to work as guest reporters for six different local newspapers. Their ambition is to reach the front page by finding the local news that engages the most. They soon discover that the task is much more difficult than they had expected.
title: Jakten på förstasidan

overview: Jay, an international student from Thailand, comes to Korea to see his friend Sung Hoon. The two enrolled in the same college "Health and Happiness" class, and need to submit a physical body assessment for their final project. While Sung Hoon already works out regularly, Jay isn't in the greatest shape, and he struggles in the gym. Enter Jin Wook, a personal trainer who takes a special interest in Jay, much to Sung Hoon's displeasure. However, there's something strange about Jin Wook – despite his kindness toward Jay, suspicions begin to rise that Jin Wook may be involved in a murder and missing person incident. Is there a happy ending in store for Jay and Sung Hoon, or will Jay's budding relationship with Jin Wook cost him an unspeakable price?
title: Eccentric Romance

overview: The crumbling friendship of friends is revealed as they uncover the death of a high school friend who left behind a five billion won insurance money.
title: Connection

overview: Universo Z is a children's series that mixes live action and animation to present the adventures of Z (a girl) and two of her friends Taby (a tablet) and Sir PC (a computer). Together they address various issues and challenges in a fun and playful way.
title: Universo Z

overview: The story of a young policeman who was falsely accused of a crime he didn't commit by a more senior corrupted policeman. During his time in prison, he comes to meet a few people with similar stories as him. Together, they break out of jail with a mission to fight against injustice and take down the corrupted.
title: Sat Suea

overview: Ichiro is a PE teacher in 1986 feared by his students for a "tough love" approach, harsh tongue and frequently "inappropriate" behavior. He's also a dad trying to raise a rebellious daughter after having lost his wife to illness. When he gets transported in time to 2024, he encounters modern sensibilities that teach him about empathy, but also gives people of today reason to rethink their own political correctness in this time traversing comedy about change.
title: Futekisetsu ni mo Hodo ga Aru!

overview: During the fast-changing 1990s, the family who held "Wonderful Taxi" and their drivers in Chiayi, even when they encountered various difficulties and problems, they still kept going with their own way.
title: A Wonderful Journey

overview: Macha and Gaby are housekeepers of an office tower. The night Macha saves Gaby from the hands of her aggressor, the girls start a quest to do justice for themselves.
title: Discrètes

overview: In terms of area, Europe is the second smallest continent, but it is an amazingly diverse area. It extends from the frozen Arctic north to the shores of Africa. And it has an epic history of colliding continents, erupting volcanoes, ice ages - and even large asteroid impacts. In the three-part series Birth Of Europe, the geological past and present of Europe examined. Geology has made Europe what it is today. It has formed the coastline, is responsible for the separation between islands and the mainland, but also the shape of the Mediterranean. All these elements are in turn responsible for how countries took shape where people live and where trade routes were established. Almost all of our continent, the history, appearance and position of the cities, in one form or another...
title: The Birth of Europe

overview: The drama is based on a popular webtoon of the same name. The story is about the youthful romance of HeeSu, an ordinary 18-year old boy, and his neighbor who has a secret.
title: HeeSu in Class 2

overview: The flower shop owner and love consultant, Su Yi, has heterochromatic pupils. She can hear others' thoughts. By a twist of fate, she meets Lin Xufeng, who has returned to start a business in his homeland. After coincidentally encountering each other several times, they gradually develop feelings for each other. Unexpectedly, their true love's kiss unlocks memories sealed for a thousand years. As their memories of past life grudges and affections awaken, what should they do in this present life?
title: Hear Your Heart

overview: It tells the story of the female protagonist Zhong Qing, who, in order to stand out in the "workplace survival battle", spares no effort or cost to "only talk about money". But one day, there was a sudden incident, and Zhong Qing's position as director disappeared instantly, only adding a special skill that could see everyone's balance. The new director, Bu Yi, saw the new official take office, and this pair of happy enemies went from their strained relationship to the sparks of love sparked by friction, and finally felt the true meaning of life.
title: Love at Second Glance

overview: George Poveromo targets the most popular saltwater game fish.
title: George Poveromo's World of Saltwater Fishing

overview: A newly in love Jens is torn between a desire for adventure and missing his girlfriend when he sets out on a crazy journey on horseback in Mongolia.
title: Jens i Mongolia

overview: Four episodes of the documentary project will tell about the role of bread in world and Russian history, science and economics, geopolitics, as well as how it affects our health.
title: Хлеб

overview: Many women find the protagonist, Ekkapop very attractive, yet is already engaged to Ngamnek, who he is about to marry. On the eve of the wedding, in a nightclub, by chance, Ekkapop ends up in an affair with Fuengfah, Ngamnek's half sister.
title: Nong Mia

overview: In this cooking series, Alexis Conran aims to prove how easy it can be to prepare decent meals in an air fryer, even for the most amateur of chefs.
title: Air Fryers Made Easy

overview: The teens at Grant High are living life in the fast lane. Between their love triangles, secrets, drama, accusations, gossip, confusion, and scandalous rumors, there's never a dull moment. The he-said, she-said gets intense! Their parents' lives are just as complicated. From paternity questions to happy reunions and unexpected romances (past and present), there's always something going on. You can't stop watching, because you've just gotta know what'll happen next.
title: The Secret Life of the American Teenager

overview: A young artist finds herself obligated to sacrifice her love story for hiding a family secret.
title: Kara Sevda

overview: Wildlife series offering new perspectives on how predators such as lions, crocodiles and cheetahs stalk, chase and bring down their prey.
title: Predator vs Prey

overview: Tessa Rivers' busy life is turned upside down when a mysterious illness leaves her paralysed from the waist down. Tessa is sent to Goldfield's Spinal Unit, where she becomes determined to walk again - by any means necessary.
title: Spinal Destination

overview: The tumultuous feelings of a divorced couple are rekindled when they become reunited years later as interns at the same hospital.
title: Emergency Couple

overview: Experience the community, the history, the isolation, and the connection of life on the remote Chatham Islands, where the land and sea govern the day to lives of the inhabitants.
title: Chatham Islanders

overview: Aaron Fa'aoso sets out on a journey to discover signature Torres Strait Islander cuisine, providing a snapshot of the food, people, and life of the tropical region.
title: Strait to the Plate

overview: Defying expectations, overcoming prejudices, and often outperforming their counterparts, these are the courageous, and unwritten stories of the women who fought the Nazis. This remarkable documentary explores the daring and unknown histories of the remarkable pilots, journalists, guerrillas and spies who fought, flew, and died across Britain, Germany, France and beyond during World War II.
title: WWII: Women on the Frontline

overview: Adapted from the novel "Sheng Shi Shou Hu" (生死守护) by Zhang Ping (张平).
title: The Defenders

overview: Mystery video blogger Yang Zhenghui uncovers a disturbing connection between the long-term disappearance of his ex-girlfriend, Liu Wei, and a ceramist named Zeng Jie. A fire that broke out at Zeng Jie's studio a year ago appears to have concealed crucial secrets about Liu Wei's fate. Now, Zeng Jie is scheming to murder his wife and take over her fortune. As Yang Zhenghui digs deeper, the logic behind the truth slowly surfaces...
title: Blemish Flaw

overview: One missing girl. Three very different lives. As the search pulls them together, each girl faces a choice that could break her—or save her. Above ground, the city gleams; below, a maze of dark tunnels hides its secrets. One girl walks that line alone, through pain and buried truths, until she uncovers what really happened. But finding the answer is only half the fight. The other half? Finding herself, and a way back to the light.
title: Runaway Princess

overview: Historical observational documentary series following a team who live the life of Victorian farmers for a year.
title: Victorian Farm

overview: Twelve mysterious letters, thirty-five years of unending anticipation. This drama focuses on the fate and romance of a small-town youth wrapped in a fantasy shell with suspense as bait and emotions at its core. It breaks traditional narrative patterns by introducing a unique dual-time-space interaction mechanism. The unpredictable weather and the blackboard in an abandoned classroom open a channel connecting two-time spaces, creating an enthralling and suspenseful experience.
title: Twelve Letters

overview: A terribly unlucky young couple stumbles into a massive villa by chance and accidentally discovers a huge sum of hidden fortune. But when trouble hits, they can no longer tell — is this a dream come true or a nightmare unfolding？
title: Wonder Wall

overview: In the cicada-filled summer in the rainy southern city of Qingyi, Xu Zhi, the "Ruijun Dark Horse," meets Chen Luzhou, the "Naked Score Topper." A misunderstanding kicks off the fiery romance between "Zhi" and "Poet Chen."
title: Be Passionately in Love

overview: A female detective, You Mingxu, from Jiangrong City, delves into western Sichuan to investigate a series of murders. Along the way, she encounters Yin Feng, a criminal psychology professor who is injured and suffering from amnesia. The two form a detective duo. With his mind reverted to a youthful state, Yin Feng, innocent and passionate, gradually opens up You Mingxu's heart, which had been closed off due to losing her mother at a young age. During their investigation, Yin Feng displays exceptional skills in criminal psychological analysis, while You Mingxu relies on her extensive experience and keen intuition. With Yin Feng's help, they solve multiple cases, growing from strangers to a well-coordinated team, and eventually, they develop feelings for each other. Yin Feng regains his memory, revealing a cold exterior but still harboring deep feelings for You Mingxu. However, he deduces that his own brother might be the one who killed You Mingxu's mother years ago. To unravel the mystery of You Mingxu's mother's death from nineteen years ago, the two uncover the truth. Ultimately, the long-buried secrets come to light, and the real culprit is brought to justice. Adapted from the web novel "Dai Wo You Zui Shi" (待我有罪时) by Ding Mo (丁墨).
title: Coming to Myself

overview: Jiang Si, the fourth lady of Dongping Bo Mansion, is reborn after dying at the hands of her lover, Yu Jin. Determined to rewrite her fate, she breaks off her engagement, outsmarts her cruel aunt, opens a perfumery, and investigates a series of mysterious crimes. She reunites with Yu Jin, and despite their unresolved past, they join forces to change tragic destinies—saving her siblings and clearing her father's name. As they overcome hardships together, Jiang Si's feelings for Yu Jin rekindle, and they work hand in hand to protect the peace of the Zhou dynasty, embracing a lifetime of prosperity.
title: Si Jin

overview: Adapted from the web novel "Spring Banquet" (春日宴) by Bai Lu Cheng Shuang (白鹭成双).
title: Chun Ri Yan

overview: Jian Mingshu, the daughter of the Jian family, survives a family massacre after accidentally falling off a cliff and losing her memory. Rescued by her love, Lu Chang, they journey together to the capital for exams. As Mingshu investigates her mysterious origins, she faces challenges but is secretly protected by Lu Chang. Through shared trials, their bond deepens, and they ultimately confirm their love, deciding to spend their lives together. Adapted from the novel "Bang Xia Gui Xu (榜下贵婿)" by Luo Ri Qiang Wei (落日薔薇).
title: Serendipity

overview: This light-hearted court-style show will bring two warring parties together to help them "bury the hatchet". Hosted by a notable Atlanta legal figure serving as the "judge" and a group of comedians and influencers as the "jury," the two groups will present their cases and the judge and jury will help them settle the beef.
title: Bury the Hatchet

overview: Species extinction, heavy rain, scorching heat, ... - science journalist and biologist Axel Wagner uses impressive film footage to show how our environment is changing and explains what we can do to avert the dramatic consequences of the climate crisis.
title: Axel Wagner und die Klimakrise

overview: In the remote woods of Sumpter, Oregon lies one of the richest gold mines in the United States that was abandoned 80 years ago when a series of tragedies gave it an infamous reputation for being haunted. Now, a new owner has decided to take on the notorious legend and reopen the mine, assembling a colorful team of miners alongside a pair of experienced paranormal investigators, in hopes of finding a fortune.
title: Ghost Mine

overview: Four cops form the "Disappearances" group, specializing in the search for missing people whose cases are considered worrying and therefore urgent. Their area of intervention includes Paris and its immediate suburbs.
title: Dossiers : Disparus

overview: Jean Calvet, a doctor practicing at the Saint-Charles clinic, married Isabelle, a former patient whom he saved from Hodgkin's disease. Seductions, threats and blackmail are part of his daily life.
title: Le Destin du Docteur Calvet

overview: In 'Chou Nogizaka Star Tanjou!', Nogizaka46 5th generation members together with MCs Ozwald challenge singing famous Showa and Heisei songs and newly also full skits.
title: Chou Nogizaka Star Tanjou!

overview: Musicians don't come much bigger or more successful than Brian Johnson and Mark Knopfler - lead singers of AC/DC and Dire Straits respectively. These two legends of rock have sold a staggering 300 million records between them, toured for more than 40 years and have each left their own indelible mark on our cultural history. Now, after a lifetime in music, Brian and Mark are taking a moment to reflect by sharing their incredible knowledge, experience and insights with each other - and the world.
title: Johnson & Knopfler's Music Legends

overview: The teaching ministry of American Southern Baptist pastor and television host Dr Robert Jeffress. He is a Senior Minister of the First Baptist Church in Dallas as well as a Fox News contributor.
title: Dr. Robert Jeffress: Pathway to Victory

overview: Topical discussions, feature stories, incisive commentary, and timely excerpts from the powerful messages of D. James Kennedy.
title: D. James Kennedy Ministries Presents: Truths That Transform

overview: Topical discussions, feature stories, incisive commentary, and timely excerpts from the powerful messages of D. James Kennedy.
title: Coral Ridge Ministries Presents: Truths That Transform

overview: Actor:eal depicts the story of two actors portraying as friends who have known for 10 years, with one harboring feelings towards the other. A new character introduces hinting a bigger picture between the two actor—it is still acting or being real?
title: Actor:eal

overview: 'Nogizaka Star Tanjou!' is a show in which Nogizaka46 4th generation members together with MCs Pekopa challenge singing traditional idol songs.
title: Nogizaka Star Tanjou!

overview: So far, they have challenged themselves with "wandering travel" in "Nogizaka Doko e" and "comedy" in "Nogizaka Skits". The fourth generation, who are the future of Nogizaka46. The next challenge for these girls is... Showa era songs! They will sing covers of hit songs from the past! They'll also perform serious duets with big-name male singers!
title: New Nogizaka Star Tanjou!

overview: The world's biggest music show is approaching, and we present the songs and artists who will take part in the Eurovision Song Contest.
title: Adresse Malmø

overview: Produced by John Cena, this series chronicles athletes vying to become the next WWE Superstars. The process will challenge them, but the biggest tests they face will be ones they create on their own.
title: WWE: Next Gen

overview: In this sports documentary, Manchester City FC offers a behind-the-scenes look into their 2022-23 season.
title: Together: Tr3ble Winners

overview: Emmy-winning journalist Harris Faulkner provides the latest news driving the day with insightful analysis and interviews with top newsmakers.
title: The Faulkner Focus

overview: Featuring an enormous interactive bridge that dares players to cross by stepping on the right answers to challenging trivia questions. Each step forward puts money in the team's bank, with bonus money for each successful crossing. However, the team gets to keep the money only if it can "beat the bridge" by returning one of its players back across before time expires in an exciting end game.
title: Beat the Bridge

overview: Tic Tac Dough is an update of NBCUniversal's classic format originally created by Robert Noah. The show is hosted by the incomparable Brooke Burns ("Master Minds", "The Chase"), who guides two contestants as they compete to place three of their marks in a row on the giant trivia board. After three rounds, the winning player moves on to face the dragon in the grand prize round, where the dragon moves strategically on the board to block the player's ability to make three-in-a-row and take home $10,000.
title: Tic Tac Dough

overview: You need to come to the shopping and entertainment center "Dostyk Plaza" and buy at least "two items". You have to make a bet on this "two items" show and correctly answer the questions sent by our viewers from all over the country.
title: Сделка

overview: Cuaderno de Campo is a documentary series that shows the best kept secrets of the Iberian fauna. On this journey, Juan Antonio Rodríguez Llano, naturalist and director of numerous nature documentaries, together with his expert film crew, will reveal the untold stories of Spain's wildlife. With a surprising and fun approach, each episode will show the life of a different wild protagonist, a star who will share his most intimate life and behaviors.
title: Cuaderno de Campo

overview: Saeba Ryo, the lead character of "City Hunter," comes off as an easily flattered guy. His true identity is that of a city hunter - a brilliant sweeper. Upon request, he sets out on the streets to "sweep" away the bad guys and teach them a lesson. This is how he earns a living. His partner Makimura Kaori takes care of him and they do everything they can to be there for each other. Angel Heart begins where these two find themselves in a desperate situation - Kaori suffers a freak accident, which leads to her untimely demise. In the midst of all this, a mysterious beautiful girl named Xiang Ying enters Ryo's life. It turns out that Xiang Ying is a heart transplant recipient, and the heart that she received belonged to the brain dead Kaori. Xiang Ying got another chance at life, thanks to Kaori's heart! Just what is Xiang Ying's true identity? As Kaori lives on within Xiang Ying, what will become of her relationship with Ryo?
title: Angel Heart

overview: Family Reservations follows culinary pioneer and world-renowned restaurateur Maren Winter, who is nearing retirement. Each of her three daughters is eager to take the reins of running her restaurant empire, the Winter Group. Ruled by her deep insecurities about becoming irrelevant, Maren pits her three daughters against each other, beginning her own dangerous descent into madness and starting the Winter sisters on their journey to freedom.
title: Family Reservations

overview: THE POWER OF FILM is a 6-part television event from legendary UCLA film Professor Emeritus Howard Suber, analyzing why certain films have remained both popular and memorable for generations. He uncovers mysteries, dispels myths, and explains with clarity and humor the defining principles and inner workings of some of the most powerful and beloved films of all time. Scenes from hundreds of these much-loved movies are featured throughout.
title: The Power of Film

overview: After an embarrassing incident at work, suburban family man William Ronald Trosper finds himself investigating a far-reaching conspiracy.
title: The Chair Company

overview: High Hopes follows Slava, Mishka, and their hilarious employees at their Hollywood-based cannabis dispensary - MMD - as they navigate the pitfalls, pleasures, and potpourri of potheads that come with running one of the fastest-growing cannabis companies in California.
title: High Hopes

overview: A look at the latest news and headlines with Sandra Smith and John Roberts
